definitions.explanation: the main or formal entrance to a building, as opposed to back or side entrances

examples.japanese: {表口|おもてぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}って→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please enter through the front entrance.

examples.japanese: {表口|おもてぐち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{閉|し}まっている→閉まる：00754_shimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{回|まわ}って→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The front entrance is closed, so please go around to the back door.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表口|おもてぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行列|ぎょうれつ}→行列：09699_gyouretsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できていた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: There was a line at the front entrance of the store.

notes:
{表口|おもてぐち} refers to the main or front entrance of a building.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{表|おもて}→表：01355_omote⟧: Front, surface, outside
- {口|ぐち}: Opening, entrance

CONTRAST WITH {裏口|うらぐち}:
- {表口|おもてぐち}: Front entrance (formal, public)
- ⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧: Back entrance (informal, service)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表口|おもてぐち}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧ (to enter from the front)
- {表口|おもてぐち}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}つ→待つ：00469_matsu⟧ (to wait at the front entrance)
- {表口|おもてぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around to the front)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{裏口|うらぐち}→裏口：04101_uraguchi⟧ (back entrance)
- ⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ (entrance, entryway)
- {入口|いりぐち} (entrance - general)
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ (main entrance - more formal)

USAGE:
- {表口|おもてぐち} emphasizes the "front" or public-facing nature
- More commonly used for shops and traditional buildings
- ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧{入口|いりぐち} or ⟦{正面|しょうめん}→正面：13189_shoumen⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧ is more formal for official buildings

REGISTER: Neutral. Common in everyday speech.
